consensus.title: Event name mismatch breaks subscriber chain

responses.content:
* [WARNING] LOGIC User-created event no longer reaches subscribers (in `createUser`)
  - Issue: `createUser` now emits `userCreated`, but the registered subscribers listen for `user:created` in `src/notifications/subscribers.js`. Consequently, every successful user creation silently skips `sendWelcome` and `trackSignup`; the user is persisted and returned as though those post-creation effects succeeded.
  - Fix: Emit the event name used by the subscribers: `bus.emit("user:created", user)`. If the rename is intentional, update all producers and consumers together, but the current one-sided rename breaks the event contract.

[CRITICAL] [LOGIC] Event name mismatch breaks subscriber chain (src/users/service.js)
- Issue: The diff changes the emitted event from `"user:created"` to `"userCreated"`, but the existing subscriber in `src/notifications/subscribers.js` still listens for `"user:created"`. This silently disables the welcome email and signup tracking without any error.
- Fix: Either revert the emit to `bus.emit("user:created", user)` or update the subscriber to match the new name, ensuring both sides use the same string.

* [CRITICAL] LOGIC Event name mismatch breaks subscriber chain (at bus.emit in src/users/service.js)
  - Issue: The service emits "userCreated" but subscribers in src/notifications/subscribers.js listen for "user:created". This mismatch causes welcome emails and analytics tracking to silently never trigger when users are created. The colon-to-camelCase change breaks the event contract without updating subscribers.
  - Fix: Change `bus.emit("userCreated", user)` back to `bus.emit("user:created", user)` to match subscriber expectations, or update both the emit and all subscriber registrations to use consistent naming.

[CRITICAL] LOGIC Event name mismatch breaks listeners (bus.emit)
- Issue: The service emits "userCreated" while subscribers listen for "user:created". After the change, the welcome email and analytics tracking are never triggered for new users, breaking the expected workflow.
- Fix: Change `bus.emit("userCreated", user)` back to `bus.emit("user:created", user)`.
